title: Collateral

panels.scene: A founder in a fleece stands on flat scrubland with a surveyor's stake and a rolled site plan, phone to ear. Behind him, an empty horizon and a single power pylon. On the ground, a printed order form stamped with a long delivery window.
panels.caption: The chips were not for sale. Texas was.

panels.scene: A marble bank office. An executive pushes a share certificate across the desk while a lender studies a wall chart of rising wafer capacity. Outside the window, cranes over a half-built fab.
panels.dialogue: Collateral? Our stake in the lab.

panels.scene: Same desk, same lender, later. A tired engineer sets down one thin folder of timestamped agent logs and an incident report. The lender does not touch it; the certificate from the previous panel is already locked in a drawer.

altText: A three-panel strip: a founder stakes out a chip plant on empty land because chips can't be bought, an executive pledges his stake in an AI lab as loan collateral, and finally an engineer offers a folder of agent logs to the same lender, who refuses to lend against them.
sourceHeadline: Musk's companies go vertical on compute; SoftBank borrows against OpenAI
